title: FOMC minutes (September 14-15 2027 meeting) — the tightest date rule in the whole minutes family
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, re-fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this lane (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, page stamp "Last Update: August 19, 2026") and re-parsed from scratch rather than inherited from either seeding proposal. It states the convention verbatim -- "The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision" -- and its 2027 panel reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*", the asterisk being the same page's "* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections". Decision day 2027-09-15 is a Wednesday and plus 21 days is Wednesday 2027-10-06 (weekday verified, not assumed). THE SEPTEMBER SUB-RULE IS 19 OF 19, THE ONLY PERFECT MEETING MONTH IN THE RECORD. This session re-parsed the live page plus the fourteen fomchistorical<year>.htm pages 2007-2020 (all HTTP 200) block by block, pairing each meeting block's own minutes URL (both the /fomc/minutes/YYYYMMDD and fomcminutesYYYYMMDD forms the Board has used) to that same block's (Released ...) string, giving 157 releases -- decisions 2007-01-31 through 2026-07-29, releases 2007-02-21 through 2026-08-19, the same count fomc-minutes-2027-08-18 reached by an independent construction. 143 of 157 sit at exactly D+21; all 14 exceptions carry a US market holiday inside the release week (Thanksgiving, Christmas/New Year, July 4) except the 2020-03-15 unscheduled meeting at D+24. EVERY ONE OF THE 19 SEPTEMBER-MEETING RELEASES 2007-2025 IS EXACTLY D+21, because a September meeting's release always lands between October 4 and October 17 and OCTOBER CONTAINS NO US MARKET HOLIDAY IN ANY YEAR -- nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200, 109,148 bytes, fetched this session) gives the full 2027 NYSE holiday set as January 1, January 18, February 15, March 26, May 31, June 18, July 5, September 6, November 25 and December 24, with nothing in October. The displacement mechanism that produced all 14 exceptions therefore cannot reach this class at all: strictly tighter than the 13-of-13 July sub-rule fomc-minutes-2027-08-18 measured, and on a series that runs the full nineteen years rather than starting in 2013. STATUS STAYS ESTIMATE and not for want of a primary: the same page states verbatim "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-07-27/28 meeting ratifying September 14-15, not a better fetch. federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2027-october.htm -- the month page that would carry the 2:00 p.m. ET release time -- returned 404 and is recorded in the ledger's probe-ref blocked array; 14:00 ET is standing convention here, not sourced for this release. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 initial-research lane (2026-09-06) after reading BOTH prior proposals -- proposals/fomc-minutes-2027-10-06.from-fhfa-hpi-2027-09-28.json and proposals/fomc-minutes-2027-10-06.from-fomc-2027-09-15.json, now inert. Their date arithmetic was re-derived from the primary and holds; their two framings are answered rather than adopted. THE DELIVERABLE IS A STACK OF REFUSALS, AND IT UPHOLDS THE FAMILY STANCE ON A BROADER TEST THAN ANY SIBLING RAN. Four sibling ledgers concluded 'a minutes day is an ordinary session' from |S&P move| alone; this lane replicates that (157 releases, 0.747% mean / 0.451% median against a 0.797% / 0.523% unconditional 2007-2026 baseline over 4,950 sessions) AND EXTENDS THE TEST TO IMPLIED VOL, which none of them measured. VIX falls on 101 of 157 minutes days (64.3%) against a 54.3% unconditional share, and against a VIX-level-matched expectation of 85.5 -- p = 0.0074. That looks like a real vol-specific effect and IT DOES NOT SURVIVE ITS OWN CONTROLS: residualising the daily VIX change on the same session's S&P return, the prior VIX level and their interaction (OLS fit on all 4,950 sessions) leaves minutes days at just -0.16 VIX points, permutation p = 0.035 both iid and stratified within +/-30 sessions -- but 3 of the 20 placebo offsets D-10..D+10 are at least as negative, so the placebo yardstick puts it near 0.15. Recorded as MIXED and not banked. THE SEPTEMBER CLUSTER IS THE DOCUMENT'S CENTRAL REFUSAL. September-meeting minutes days look spectacular: VIX down 17 of 19 and the S&P up 16 of 19, both the maximum of all twelve meeting months, with P(>=17 VIX-down) = 0.0019 level-matched and 0.0008 against the matched October 4-17 calendar window, and the neighbouring sessions show nothing (8-11 of 19 at every offset D-5..D+5, and the surrounding +/-5 sessions run a 51.05% VIX-down share with a +0.003 mean change). Both halves still die. The S&P direction is P(>=16 of 19) = 0.0065 raw against a 54.4% base rate and 0.078 after the twelve-way meeting-month scan it was found by. And the VIX cluster IS THE INDEX MOVE: residualised, the September sign falls from 17 of 19 to 12 of 19 (base 54.1%) at p = 0.13-0.16. One finding, not two, and it fails as a vol claim. THE SEP HYPOTHESIS THIS EVENT WAS PROPOSED ON IS ALSO REFUTED. Minutes of a Summary-of-Economic-Projections meeting are not distinguishable from the rest: 51 of 75 VIX-down against 50 of 82, two-sample permutation p = 0.211, residualised p = 0.151. And the from-fomc-2027-09-15 proposal's headline -- that this is 'the first meeting at which a 2030 dot exists at all' -- is TRUE AND NOT DISTINCTIVE: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomc_projectionsfaqs.htm (HTTP 200, 84,788 bytes, fetched this session) states verbatim that 'The projections made in September and December are for the current year, for the subsequent three years, and for the longer run', so EVERY September SEP introduces a new terminal year. 2030 in 2027 is exactly as routine as 2029 was in 2026. IMPACT is medium, matching all five canonical fomc-minutes entries and the from-fhfa-hpi proposal (the from-fomc-2027-09-15 proposal filed low; medium is kept for family consistency, and nothing in either reading is tradeable either way). TWO ADJACENCIES PROPOSED IN THE SAME PR, both filling holes in series this calendar already tracks: proposals/fomc-2027-10-27.from-fomc-minutes-2027-10-06.json (the October 26-27 2027 decision, D+21 from this release, the only 2027 FOMC meeting with no entry) and proposals/fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16.from-fomc-minutes-2027-10-06.json (D+10, the gap in the blackout series after 2027-09-04). The +/-5-day corridor around this release is otherwise EMPTY; +/-14 days picks up consumer-confidence-2027-09-28 and fhfa-hpi-2027-09-28 at D-8. Estimate widens caution only and licenses nothing; symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates- or minutes-keyed.
